gaps.explanation: detail[] holds the A-1 budgetary-basis schedule (p8; actuals cover all governmental funds), Total Revenues 6,447,039, which lists Interest/Dividends 89,847 among revenues. The governmental funds statement (p4) prints Interest/Dividends 89,847 under Other Financing Sources (Uses), below Total revenues 6,357,192 (JSON other_financing 89,847). 6,447,039 - 89,847 = 6,357,192. All other A-1 revenue lines equal the p4 Total column. A classification difference between two printed totals; no detail line is missing or duplicated.
